name: log_diaper
description: Log a diaper change in PoopJob. type must be poop, pee or mix. color is optional and records the stool color; it is valid only for poop and mix, never for pee. occurred_at is optional and defaults to now.

type.description: Required. One of: poop, pee, mix.

color.description: Optional. One of: meconium, transitional, mustard, yellowgreen, tan, pale, red, black. Do not pass with type pee. Leave it out when the color was not checked.

occurred_at.description: Optional. When the diaper happened, as ISO 8601, for example "2026-01-12T08:30:00+02:00". A value without an offset is read in the configured timezone. Defaults to now.
